parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the application name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the stream name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-center-stream-rate-data --app-name liveApp0000 --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2024-03-05T18:00:53Z --end-time 2024-03-05T18:01:03Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveCenterStreamRateData --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2024-03-05T18:01:03Z' --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --StartTime '2024-03-05T18:00:53Z' --AppName liveApp0000
